arguments.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a nice, clean start, but it currently only shows your email address with no other content. I'd suggest adding an "About Me" section, a portfolio or list of your work/interests, and maybe a contact form to make it more engaging and informative for visitors. Looking forward to seeing it grow!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's great that you mention your love of hiking! To make the blog more compelling, I'd suggest adding actual blog posts or stories about your hiking adventures, photos from the trails, and maybe a section on your favorite hiking spots or tips. That would give visitors a real reason to keep coming back. Keep it up!
